title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
abstract: arXiv:2610.35832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. translated_title: 基于EBench的前沿智能体画像：从直接控制到带策略的智能体执行框架
translated_abstract: 前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）无需针对机器人的专门训练即可控制机器人，但它们的能力与经过后训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型（WAM）策略在不同操作需求下如何比较与协同，仍有待全面评估。在本报告中，我们在EBench基准上将GPT-6-Astra作为智能体的核心进行评估，该智能体通过一个智能体执行框架（agent harness）控制机器人，并采用与后训练策略完全相同的视觉和本体感觉观测协议。我们研究了两种智能体配置：直接控制（智能体直接生成路点命令）和带策略的执行框架（智能体还可以调用后训练的VLA或WAM策略来执行动作）。在直接控制模式下，该智能体相对于后训练策略取得了具有竞争力的整体性能，在短时程任务上表现领先，并在各泛化维度上展现出最小的性能波动……
tldr: 该论文在EBench基准上系统评估了前沿多模态大模型GPT-6-Astra作为机器人控制智能体的能力，发现其无需机器人特定训练、直接生成控制命令即可达到与后训练VLA/WAM策略相当的性能，并在短时程任务和泛化稳定性上表现最优。
en_tdlr: This report profiles the frontier multimodal LLM GPT-6-Astra as a robot-controlling agent on EBench, showing that direct control without robot-specific training achieves competitive performance with post-trained VLA/WAM policies, leading on short-horizon tasks and exhibiting the most stable generalization.
